body.heading: Choose your character
paragraphs: Pick a character from a favourite book. Find one or two things to wear that feel like them.
Look in the mirror. A cape, a crown, or a pair of ears can do all the work.

body.heading: Act the story
paragraphs: Tell or act the best scene from the story. Big voices and big gestures welcome.
Take a bow at the end, still in costume. Actors always take a bow.

takeaway: A hat and a scarf can turn you into anyone in any story.
materials: Hats, scarves, and old clothes for dressing up
safetyNotes: An adult checks costumes first; keep scarves loose and never tied around the neck.
screenFreeExtension: Dress up as an animal and let your family guess which story you are from.
